name: agentvalet
description: Governed credential broker for AI agents. Lets Claude Desktop call approved platforms (Slack, GitHub, Airtable, Stripe, Gmail, and more) through the AgentValet proxy with audit, scope attenuation, and human approval for destructive actions.
long_description: AgentValet is an AIMS-compliant identity and governance layer for AI agents. This bundle installs the AgentValet MCP server locally and connects it to your AgentValet account. The bundle ships only the agent's signing key. Platform credentials never leave the AgentValet vault. All actions are recorded in the audit log.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Your AgentValet agent ID (starts with agt_). Run `agent_register` if you don't have one yet.

owner_id.title: Owner ID
owner_id.description: Your AgentValet owner ID (UUID). Find it in the dashboard at agentvalet.ai/settings.

proxy_url.title: Proxy URL
proxy_url.description: AgentValet proxy endpoint. Leave default unless self-hosting.

agent_private_key_b64.title: Agent Private Key (base64)
agent_private_key_b64.description: Base64-encoded RS256 private key for this agent. Pre-filled when installing from a dashboard invite; otherwise generated by `agent_register`. Treat as a secret.

confirm_install.title: Type ACCEPT to install
confirm_install.description: Type ACCEPT (any case) to enable the Save button. The fields above are already filled in from your dashboard invite — just type ACCEPT here and click Save.
